title: World
description: A fictional universe: the root every other resource belongs to (Wikidata narrative universe).

crs.description: Default coordinate reference system IRI for this world's maps.

owner.description: User id of the world owner.

map.description: How the world's map is drawn beneath its records. With nothing else said, from the tiles the world holds, at /v1/worlds/{world}/tiles/{z}/{x}/{y}.png. A world whose pictures are hosted elsewhere may name a template instead.

source.description: `tiles` draws pictures somebody made; `terrain` draws the world from its own terrain, at any depth.

tiles.description: URL template for one tile, with {z}, {x} and {y} where the zoom, column and row go. Absent means the world's own tiles.

minZoom.description: The coarsest zoom the tiles cover.

maxZoom.description: The finest zoom the tiles cover.

attribution.description: Who drew the map, shown on it.
